issues.detail: The instructions lack coverage of error handling and edge cases such as installation failures or network errors.
Setup instructions omit Windows-specific commands, limiting usability on Windows platforms.

scenarios.name: directory-discovery-recursive
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes most required ffuf options but omits recursion flags, whereas Response A provides no useful content.

scenarios.name: subdomain-enumeration-dns
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully meets the rubric by using ffuf with the required options and outputting a CSV, whereas Response B does not use ffuf at all.

scenarios.name: api-endpoint-discovery-auth
scenarios.rationale: Response A uses ffuf with most required flags but omits -ac and writes to results.md instead of endpoints.md, whereas Response B does not use ffuf at all.
